status: Hoverboard rider concept for review before Meshy
prompt:
Edit the provided Neon Exorcist character concept. Preserve the same male character identity, hairstyle and topknot, smooth single-screen orange-to-magenta neon visor covering the eyes and entire nose with mouth and jaw exposed, fitted technical jacket, floating ritual talismans, black cyberpunk streetwear, orange/yellow/cyan/magenta neon accents, realistic detailed materials and subdued gray studio setting.

Replace the individual hover sneakers with ordinary sleek futuristic street sneakers, and put the player RIDING ONE ACTUAL HOVERBOARD. Both feet must be visibly planted firmly on the top surface of ONE connected skateboard-shaped hovering deck. No separate hover soles, no separate foot platforms, no wheels.

Board design: one clearly readable solid elongated deck approximately 100 cm long and 30 cm wide, gently upturned nose and tail, black composite shell, textured foot pads, beveled armor panels, neon cyan and orange edge strips with magenta details. Visible integrated anti-gravity emitters underneath produce restrained blue-cyan glow and warm orange accents. Board is floating 15–20 cm above the floor with a clear air gap, soft shadow and colored reflections below. The entire board and both tips must fit inside the image.

Pose: change the lower-body pose to a convincing relaxed sideways skateboard/snowboard riding stance, feet shoulder-width apart along the board's length, both feet turned across the width of the deck, knees slightly bent, balanced hips, upper body turned somewhat toward camera, hands relaxed slightly out for balance. Preserve the outfit design and anatomy. Board lies diagonally across the foreground so its shape, length and both planted feet are unmistakable. The character is clearly a rider standing on a single vehicle, not floating above it.

Composition: one full-body character including head, hands, both shoes and whole hoverboard, generous margins, three-quarter view, polished AAA realistic game concept art. Clean dark gray studio backdrop, restrained neon bounce light, no city background, no duplicate views, no inset panels, no text, no logos, no watermark.
